what: T1WEAK, pre-registered 2026-10-29 21:35 UTC, staged and awaiting credit
the_arm: Full-length training (349,999,104 steps) from scratch on the CLEAN Tier 1 references for the eleven clips below 0.35 AUC, with the precision recipe: start_curriculum, orientation_reward std 0.3, object_position std 0.08, seed 42, scene.support per clip, world_count 1 at eval. NOT a warm start -- the measured rule is that warm-starting a clip below 0.35 never adopts (0 of 4), and 12 of 12 rejected clips came back worse on MPPE, because 50M steps from a settled policy cannot relearn a clip it never solved.
why_these_eleven: They are every clip under 0.35 in the current entry and they sum to 2.074 of AUC where the 19 good clips average 0.7228. They are also why Tier 1 is 12th of 23 while our best clips match the leader's per-clip quality (e08 is 0.9236 at 1.43 cm).
cost: 11 clips x 4.4 box-hours x $0.68 = $32.91, plus bring-up and image build on each box. On 3 boxes that is ~16 h wall clock, inside the 24 h deletion authority; on 4 boxes ~12 h. Call it $36 with overhead, and $40 of credit covers it with a recovery margin for Brev's ~1/3 create-failure rate.

projection.basis: 0.60-0.80 is where clean-reference training put every clip that works today; the 19 good clips average 0.7228 and were trained the same way.

rank_effect: tier1-auc 12th -> 5th-8th, and the gates follow: each clip that crosses 3 cm adds 0.0333 of MP-SR and each that crosses 10 cm adds 0.0333 of SP-SR, where the teams immediately above us are 0.03334 away on both. About +19 rank points across the four Tier 1 boards (results/t1_rank_sensitivity.json).
the_bar_written_before_launch: A clip is adopted into the entry only if its kit AUC improves on the current per-clip record AND no other board regresses -- the same rule the warm-start programme used, which has never once cost a board point. The arm counts as having worked if the 30-clip entry mean reaches 0.60, i.e. at least +0.073. If it lands under 0.56 the clean- reference-training hypothesis is wrong for weak clips and the remaining credit stops.
what_is_not_yet_built: The launcher: full-length training on a Tier 1 asset tree reuses brev/run_tier2_full.sh with ARM_FLAGS for the precision recipe, which has run 30 clips before, but the per-box clip packing and the plan file still need writing. ~30 minutes of free work, which I will do rather than leave the money waiting.

launch_is_ready.status: staged, split, dry-run verified. Awaiting credit only.
launch_is_ready.command: bash $S/launch_t1weak.sh a   # then b, then c, creates spaced ~20 s apart
launch_is_ready.balanced_why: 4/4/3 rather than 5/3/3: four clips at 4.4 h is 17.6 h plus bring-up, inside the 21 h box deadline and 22 h backstop. A five-clip box would run 22 h and race its own deletion authority.
launch_is_ready.per_box_asset_trees: One tree per box, not one shared tree. t1_eval_clean.sh's preflight compares parquets found in ASSETS against the box's clip count, so a shared 11-clip tree against a 4-clip plan reads INCOMPLETE and refuses to launch -- which is exactly what it did to the strong-four relaunch this morning. a: 4 parquets/4 usda/25 files/127M, b: same, c: 3/3/19/76M.
launch_is_ready.new_code: brev/run_t1weak.sh, an adapter: t1_eval_clean.sh hands its box script PLAN as an env var while run_tier2_full.sh takes the map positionally. Two proven scripts, translated rather than bent.
launch_is_ready.dry_run_evidence: DRY_RUN=1 on box a's map printed the real training command: task.parquet under /v2d/assets/t1weak, total_environment_steps=349999104, save_interval=49999872, scene.support resolved per clip, reset.reset_voc_scale=0.0 from the start-curriculum patch, object_position std 0.08 and object_orientation std 0.3 applied, seed 42, then one evaluation per checkpoint.
launch_is_ready.known_cosmetic_defect: run_tier2_full.sh hardcodes logging.project=v2d-t2-combined and run_name=t2_eXX, so these Tier 1 runs will be labelled t2 in the offline W&B dirs. Logging is offline and the results tree is what gets scored, so this is mislabelling rather than a fault, and I would rather not edit a runner that has driven 30 clips for a cosmetic fix.
